name: DIMENSION X
description: A portal-fluid and Evil Morty inspired Geometry Dash UI overhaul.

enable-pulse.name: Wordmark pulse
enable-pulse.description: Gently pulses the main menu wordmark and subtitle.

footer-opacity.name: Footer opacity
footer-opacity.description: Opacity of the dark footer band. Lower it if it covers the bottom menu buttons.

themed-pause.name: Themed pause menu
themed-pause.description: Adds the DIMENSION X rails and wordmark to the pause menu.

portal-background.name: Animated portal background
portal-background.description: Draws a slowly rotating green and cyan vortex behind the main menu.

portal-opacity.name: Portal brightness
portal-opacity.description: How strong the portal effect is (0-255). Lower it if buttons are hard to read.

show-characters.name: Show original characters
show-characters.description: Shows the Warden and Sprocket silhouettes on the main menu.

custom-background.name: Custom background image
custom-background.description: Optional image shown behind the main menu. Leave empty to use the default.
